plan.title: Annual Donation Summary 2023
plan.subtitle: Key metrics and trends for donations received this year

panels.title: Total donations
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total FROM donor_transactions WHERE CAST("Date" AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'

panels.title: Unique donors
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS n FROM donor_transactions WHERE CAST("Date" AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'

panels.title: Payment mode distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode", SUM("Amount") AS total FROM donor_transactions WHERE CAST("Date" AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top cities by donation volume
panels.sql: SELECT "City", SUM("Amount") AS total FROM donor_transactions WHERE CAST("Date" AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Monthly donation trend
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', CAST("Date" AS TIMESTAMP)) AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total FROM donor_transactions WHERE CAST("Date" AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 donors
panels.sql: SELECT "Donor", SUM("Amount") AS total FROM donor_transactions WHERE CAST("Date" AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This year, we received {{p1}} in total donations from {{p2}} unique supporters. The most common payment method was {{p3.Mode}}, accounting for {{p3.total}} of the total. Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Delhi were our top three cities by donation volume, with combined contributions of {{p4.total}}. The donation trend showed steady growth, with the highest monthly total of {{p5.total}} in {{p5.month}}. Our top donor contributed {{p6.total}} through multiple transactions.
